```{r}
#fmri data
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
tsv_files <- list.files("train_tsv", pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
extract_upper_tri <- function(file_path) {
  mat <- as.matrix(read_tsv(file_path, col_names = FALSE))
  upper_tri <- mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]  
  return(upper_tri)
}
patient_data <- t(sapply(tsv_files, extract_upper_tri))
patient_df <- as.data.frame(patient_data)
rownames(patient_df) <- basename(tsv_files)
library(tibble)
patient_df <- rownames_to_column(patient_df, var = "participant_id")
fmri <- patient_df
fmri$participant_id <- substr(fmri$participant_id, 5, 16)
fmri$participant_id <- sub("_.*", "", fmri$participant_id)
library(dplyr)
#metadata
meta_train <- read.csv("training_metadata.csv")
meta_test <- read.csv("test_metadata.csv")
#missing values of meta_train
colSums(is.na(meta_train))
#class of meta_train
sapply(meta_train, class)
#data cleaning
library(dplyr)
#impute bmi by sex
bmi_means <- meta_train %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(bmi_mean = mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE))
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi)  
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean) 
#turn NAs into Missing
meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))
library(dplyr)
num_cols <- names(meta_train)[sapply(meta_train, is.numeric)]
num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, "age")

train_means <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
train_sds   <- sapply(meta_train[num_cols], sd,   na.rm = TRUE)

meta_train <- meta_train %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(num_cols),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))
#same for test data
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  left_join(bmi_means, by = "sex") %>%
  mutate(
    bmi = ifelse(is.na(bmi), bmi_mean, bmi) 
  ) %>%
  select(-bmi_mean)  
meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "Missing", .)))

cols_to_scale_test <- intersect(num_cols, names(meta_test))

meta_test <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(cols_to_scale_test),
    ~ (. - train_means[cur_column()]) / train_sds[cur_column()]
  ))
#merge fmri data with metadata
data <- left_join(fmri,meta_train, by = "participant_id")
#detect missing value
sum(is.na(data))
sum(is.na(meta_train))
sum(is.na(fmri))
anti_join(fmri, meta_train, by = "participant_id")
library(caret)
columns_to_encode <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.character)]
columns_to_encode <- setdiff(columns_to_encode, "participant_id")
dummies <- dummyVars(~ ., data = data[, columns_to_encode, drop = FALSE], fullRank = TRUE)
onehot_matrix <- predict(dummies, newdata = data)
data2 <- bind_cols(
  data %>% select(participant_id, where(is.numeric)),
  as.data.frame(onehot_matrix)
)
```

```{r}
library(torch)
library(dplyr)
library(xgboost)
library(rBayesianOptimization)

fmri_cols <- names(data2)[2:19902]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data2), c("participant_id", "age", fmri_cols))

X_fmri <- as.matrix(data2[, fmri_cols])
X_meta <- as.matrix(data2[, meta_cols])
y_all  <- data2$age

set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(data2)
n_test <- floor(0.2 * n)
shuf_idx <- sample(1:n)

X_fmri <- X_fmri[shuf_idx, ]
X_meta <- X_meta[shuf_idx, ]
y_all  <- y_all[shuf_idx]

X_fmri_train <- X_fmri[-(1:n_test), ]
X_fmri_test  <- X_fmri[1:n_test, ]
X_meta_train <- X_meta[-(1:n_test), ]
X_meta_test  <- X_meta[1:n_test, ]
y_train      <- y_all[-(1:n_test)]
y_test       <- y_all[1:n_test]

fmri_mean <- apply(X_fmri_train, 2, mean)
fmri_sd   <- apply(X_fmri_train, 2, sd)
X_fmri_train <- scale(X_fmri_train, center = fmri_mean, scale = fmri_sd)
X_fmri_test  <- scale(X_fmri_test, center = fmri_mean, scale = fmri_sd)

latent_dim <- 256
input_dim <- ncol(X_fmri_train)

autoencoder <- nn_module(
  initialize = function() {
    self$encoder <- nn_sequential(
      nn_linear(input_dim, 512),
      nn_relu(),
      nn_dropout(0.3),
      nn_linear(512, latent_dim)
    )
    self$decoder <- nn_sequential(
      nn_linear(latent_dim, 512),
      nn_relu(),
      nn_dropout(0.3),
      nn_linear(512, input_dim)
    )
  },
  forward = function(x) {
    encoded <- self$encoder(x)
    decoded <- self$decoder(encoded)
    list(encoded = encoded, decoded = decoded)
  }
)

model <- autoencoder()
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 1e-3)
loss_fn <- nn_mse_loss()

X_train_torch <- torch_tensor(X_fmri_train, dtype = torch_float())
batch_size <- 64
n_epochs <- 100
n_batches <- ceiling(nrow(X_fmri_train) / batch_size)

best_loss <- Inf
patience <- 10
no_improve <- 0

for (epoch in 1:n_epochs) {
  model$train()
  total_loss <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:n_batches) {
    idx <- ((i - 1) * batch_size + 1):min(i * batch_size, nrow(X_fmri_train))
    x_batch <- X_train_torch[idx, ]
    
    optimizer$zero_grad()
    out <- model(x_batch)
    loss <- loss_fn(out$decoded, x_batch)
    loss$backward()
    optimizer$step()
    
    total_loss <- total_loss + loss$item()
  }

  val_loss <- total_loss / n_batches
  if (epoch %% 5 == 0) cat(sprintf("Epoch %d - Val Loss: %.4f\n", epoch, val_loss))
  
  if (val_loss < best_loss) {
    best_loss <- val_loss
    no_improve <- 0
    torch_save(model$state_dict(), "best_autoencoder.pt")
  } else {
    no_improve <- no_improve + 1
    if (no_improve >= patience) {
      cat("Early stopping at epoch", epoch, "\n")
      break
    }
  }
}

model$load_state_dict(torch_load("best_autoencoder.pt"))
model$eval()

X_fmri_train_encoded <- as_array(model$encoder(torch_tensor(X_fmri_train, dtype = torch_float())))
X_fmri_test_encoded  <- as_array(model$encoder(torch_tensor(X_fmri_test,  dtype = torch_float())))

X_train_final <- cbind(X_fmri_train_encoded, X_meta_train)
X_test_final  <- cbind(X_fmri_test_encoded,  X_meta_test)

dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train_final, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test_final,  label = y_test)

opt_func <- function(eta, max_depth, subsample, colsample_bytree, gamma) {
  params <- list(
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse",
    eta = eta,
    max_depth = as.integer(max_depth),
    subsample = subsample,
    colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree,
    gamma = gamma
  )
  
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 300,
    nfold = 5,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  list(Score = -min(cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean), Pred = 0)
}

set.seed(42)
opt <- BayesianOptimization(
  FUN = opt_func,
  bounds = list(
    eta = c(0.01, 0.1),
    max_depth = c(3L, 9L),
    subsample = c(0.6, 1.0),
    colsample_bytree = c(0.6, 1.0),
    gamma = c(0, 0.2)
  ),
  init_points = 10,
  n_iter = 20
)

best <- opt$Best_Par
final_params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eta = best[["eta"]],
  max_depth = as.integer(best[["max_depth"]]),
  subsample = best[["subsample"]],
  colsample_bytree = best[["colsample_bytree"]],
  gamma = best[["gamma"]],
  eval_metric = "rmse"
)

model_final <- xgb.train(
  params = final_params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 300,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain, test = dtest),
  verbose = 1
)

# ---- 8. 最终评估 ----
preds <- predict(model_final, dtest)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - y_test)^2))
r2   <- 1 - sum((preds - y_test)^2) / sum((y_test - mean(y_test))^2)

cat("\n===== Final Test Results =====\n")
cat("Final Test RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")
cat("Final Test R²:", round(r2, 4), "\n")

```

```{r}
var_y_test <- var(y_test)
result_table <- opt$History %>%
  dplyr::select(eta, max_depth, subsample, colsample_bytree, gamma, Value) %>%
  mutate(
    RMSE = -Value,
    R2 = 1 - (RMSE^2) / var_y_test
  ) %>%
  arrange(RMSE)
head(result_table, 10
write.csv(result_table, "xgb_bayesopt_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
